Energy Losses: 16.8%
Energy losses reduced to 16.8% compared to
the 18% of 2021, on account of increased loss
reduction activities in local communities, new
connections, and network optimisation.
Insourcing of some field work previously carried
out by third party contractors has greatly
contributed to the positive outcome.
The Company shall continue to roll out its loss
reduction strategy which targets both technical
and non-technical losses.
